gitCommit.body:
test(coverage): Phase 4 — cover the 0% component/page/module layer (floor 73→82) (#234)

* test(upload): jsdom behavioral tests for PhotoUpload + PoolUpload (Phase 4)

Behavioral jsdom tests for the two 0%-covered upload components, mocking
only true boundaries and exercising the real @/lib/uploads helpers
(isHeifFile, partitionPoolFiles, MAX_UPLOAD_*/POOL_* limits).

PhotoUpload (5): happy single-file (preview -> POST FormData with the File
-> window.location.reload), HEIC -> convertHeifToJpeg -> converted JPEG
uploaded, upload error (fetch !ok -> error shown, no reload), non-image and
over-size rejected up front. Note: PhotoUpload uses FormData + reload, not
@vercel/blob/client or next/navigation.

PoolUpload (4): multi-file (N private uploads to the pool token endpoint ->
poll until rows land -> single router.refresh), pre-flight skip via real
partitionPoolFiles (unsupported type skipped, never uploaded, no refresh),
upload throws (row errors, no refresh), HEIC converted before upload. Fake
timers drive the delay()/waitForPooledRows poll.

Pins an a11y gap (purses-orsx): upload error/status text has no aria-live
region, so failures aren't announced to screen readers. Not fixed (test-only).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
